-- Screenshot shows "PATROL 120 B - PATROL CATERPILLAR 120B" in OUTROS SERVIÇOS - this one WORKS
-- Tag extracted would be "PATROL 120 B"
-- Let's check item_despesa_importado for PATROL
SELECT DISTINCT equipamentoTag, equipamentoDescricao, equipamentoSistemaId 
FROM item_despesa_importado 
WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001 
AND equipamentoTag LIKE '%PATROL%'
LIMIT 10;
